quarterly_data.quarter: Naver press release: NAVER Lee Haejin Meets Brookfield's Bruce Flatt, Confirms (09-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NAVER founder Lee Haejin met Brookfield chairman Bruce Flatt on September 3 for follow-up discussions on the 1 GW AI factory project, which the release says is on track. Brookfield has committed to invest up to US$9 billion in the 200 MW first phase of NAVER and NVIDIA's 1 GW AI factory project and plans to continue the partnership through subsequent phases; Flatt said Brookfield would also support the efficient procurement of equipment and infrastructure and help attract customers.
quarterly_data.figure: 1 GW AI factory project; 200 MW first phase; Brookfield commitment up to US$9 billion
